suggestions.name: 微信零钱
suggestions.reason: 最常见的零钱与红包余额，需记录归属与提取方式。
suggestions.reasonEn: Wallet balance and red packets; record ownership and withdrawal.

suggestions.name: 支付宝余额
suggestions.reason: 余额、余额宝与绑卡信息集中在一处。
suggestions.reasonEn: Balance, money fund and linked cards in one place.

suggestions.name: 银行卡
suggestions.reason: 工资、理财与自动扣款的主要通道。
suggestions.reasonEn: Primary channel for salary, wealth products and auto-debits.

suggestions.name: 证券账户
suggestions.reason: 股票、基金与打新资金需要单独交接。
suggestions.reasonEn: Securities and IPO funds need a separate handover.

suggestions.name: 基金账户
suggestions.reason: 场外基金与定投计划容易被忽略。
suggestions.reasonEn: Off-exchange funds and recurring investment plans are easy to miss.

suggestions.name: 云闪付
suggestions.reason: 银行卡聚合与优惠权益。
suggestions.reasonEn: Card aggregation and discount benefits.

suggestions.name: 微信账号
suggestions.reason: 联系人、群聊、朋友圈与微信支付关联。
suggestions.reasonEn: Contacts, groups, moments and payment linkage.

suggestions.name: QQ 账号
suggestions.reason: 老联系人、QQ 邮箱与空间资料。
suggestions.reasonEn: Legacy contacts, QQ mail and profile data.

suggestions.name: 微博账号
suggestions.reason: 公开内容与私信，需明确纪念或注销。
suggestions.reasonEn: Public posts and DMs need a memorial or deletion decision.

suggestions.name: 小红书账号
suggestions.reason: 笔记、收藏与商业合作记录。
suggestions.reasonEn: Notes, saves and brand collaboration records.

suggestions.name: 抖音账号
suggestions.reason: 作品、直播收益与绑定钱包。
suggestions.reasonEn: Videos, live income and linked wallet.

suggestions.name: 哔哩哔哩账号
suggestions.reason: 稿件、收藏与大会员权益。
suggestions.reasonEn: Uploads, favorites and membership benefits.

suggestions.name: 百度网盘
suggestions.reason: 家庭照片、备份与共享链接。
suggestions.reasonEn: Family photos, backups and shared links.

suggestions.name: 阿里云盘
suggestions.reason: 大文件与跨端同步资料。
suggestions.reasonEn: Large files and cross-device sync.

suggestions.name: 夸克网盘
suggestions.reason: 浏览器与网盘联合保存的资料。
suggestions.reasonEn: Files saved across browser and cloud.

suggestions.name: 腾讯微云
suggestions.reason: QQ/微信生态内的历史文件。
suggestions.reasonEn: Legacy files in the QQ/WeChat ecosystem.

suggestions.name: 视频会员
suggestions.reason: 自动续费与家庭共享权益。
suggestions.reasonEn: Auto-renewals and family sharing.

suggestions.name: 音乐会员
suggestions.reason: 曲库、歌单与家庭组。
suggestions.reasonEn: Library, playlists and family group.

suggestions.name: 云服务器
suggestions.reason: 网站、应用与数据托管的根凭证。
suggestions.reasonEn: Root credentials for sites, apps and hosted data.

suggestions.name: 域名
suggestions.reason: 域名续费、DNS 与备案信息。
suggestions.reasonEn: Renewal, DNS and registration records.

suggestions.name: 软件订阅
suggestions.reason: 办公、设计与 AI 工具的账号与账单。
suggestions.reasonEn: Accounts and bills for work, design and AI tools.

suggestions.name: 手机
suggestions.reason: 设备锁、云备份与 SIM 卡。
suggestions.reasonEn: Device lock, cloud backup and SIM.

suggestions.name: 电脑
suggestions.reason: 本地资料、加密盘与登录态。
suggestions.reasonEn: Local files, encrypted disks and sessions.

suggestions.name: NAS
suggestions.reason: 家庭数据与照片备份的集中点。
suggestions.reasonEn: Central store for family data and photo backups.

suggestions.name: 路由器
suggestions.reason: 网络配置、宽带账号与智能家居入口。
suggestions.reasonEn: Network config, broadband account and smart-home entry.

suggestions.name: 身份证
suggestions.reason: 证件影像与用途说明，注意最小化保存。
suggestions.reasonEn: ID images and usage notes; minimize storage.

suggestions.name: 护照
suggestions.reason: 出行证件与有效期。
suggestions.reasonEn: Travel document and expiry.

suggestions.name: 房产证
suggestions.reason: 产权、抵押与共有人信息。
suggestions.reasonEn: Ownership, mortgage and co-owners.

suggestions.name: 保险单
suggestions.reason: 受益人、保额与理赔联系方式。
suggestions.reasonEn: Beneficiaries, coverage and claims contact.

suggestions.name: 房产
suggestions.reason: 地址、钥匙/门锁与维护记录。
suggestions.reasonEn: Address, keys/locks and maintenance.

suggestions.name: 车辆
suggestions.reason: 行驶证、保险与停车/充电信息。
suggestions.reasonEn: Registration, insurance and parking/charging.

suggestions.name: 贵重物品
suggestions.reason: 首饰、收藏与保管位置。
suggestions.reasonEn: Jewelry, collections and storage location.

suggestions.name: 企业微信
suggestions.reason: 组织、客户与审批记录。
suggestions.reasonEn: Org, customers and approval records.

suggestions.name: 公众号
suggestions.reason: 内容资产、粉丝与广告收益。
suggestions.reasonEn: Content assets, followers and ad revenue.

suggestions.name: 小程序
suggestions.reason: 代码、云开发与支付配置。
suggestions.reasonEn: Code, cloud functions and payment config.

suggestions.name: 商家后台
suggestions.reason: 订单、结算与保证金。
suggestions.reasonEn: Orders, settlement and deposits.
